nodes.name: agentWorkflow.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript type definitions for agent orchestrator workflow state: phases, review outcomes, linked sessions, diff/test stats, review feedback and config, orchestrator config/state, and agent defaults.

nodes.name: common.ts
nodes.summary: Small shared type definitions for todo entries and comment entries reused across work item and project types.

nodes.name: projectRecords.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions for project organization records and project metadata, mirroring the Rust backend's ProjectMeta and ProjectOrg structs, including agent-default inheritance for new work items.

nodes.name: routines.ts
nodes.summary: Type and const-enum definitions for scheduled routines: triggers (one-time/cron), fire status, output mode, concurrency and catch-up policies, run templates, and routine fire results.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the `as const` object + derived union type pattern to emulate string enums in TypeScript.

nodes.name: workItems.ts
nodes.summary: Central type definitions for work items: history events, assignee targets, execution locks, close-out state, work products, frontmatter, the enriched/resolved work item view, and kanban/gantt/calendar view data plus batch operation results.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the `as const` object + derived union type pattern extensively for status/kind enums; composes types imported from agentWorkflow, common, and routines into the larger WorkItem domain model.
